note: args = [fn, args]: fn names an exported function of src/shortcut.ts and args is its argument list, so each case is {name, fn, args, expected}. URL expectations come from Python urllib.parse.quote(s, safe='') (RFC 3986), not from the TypeScript code, and follow Apple's documented Shortcuts URL scheme: shortcuts://run-shortcut?name=&input=text&text= and shortcuts://x-callback-url/run-shortcut with x-success, x-cancel and x-error. A pending request lives 30 minutes (1,800,000 ms) and works once.
